styles.name: BLACK Bib apron in poly cotton with OH ties and cloth loop — Rick Stein logo
styles.desc: BIB APRON · No pocket OH non tangle ties OH towel loop · Rick Stein logo embroidered top right-hand corner as worn, in white
trims: Oliver harvey woven british button label set into right side seam as worn. 4cm down from top edge.
Oliver harvey wash instructions set under OH woven label right side seam as worn / Wash - 65%recycled polyester/35% organic cotton/60 degree wash / tumble dry/ 2 dot iron/do not bleach / p dry clean
OH black non tangle tape cut at 39cm to make towel loop
mfg: Make neck strap. Fold in half and enclose raw edges. Edge stitch long edge to close seam.
Set bib facing and insert neck straps. Edge stitched side of neck strap to be set to outside edge of bib and ensure good side of strap to topside.
Top of bib 6MM TOPSTITCHED.
Bib facing - Fold in 10mm to neaten lower edge. Edge stitch lower edge of facing which forms 5.5cm topstitching to front

Armhole double turned and topstitching to finish 6mm from edge. Cut towel loop at 39cm. Fold loop in half and set towel loop 17cm from cut edge of left side seam as worn. Stitch down towel loop to follow armhole stitching.
Hem - double turned and topstitching to finish 12mm from edge
Sides - double turned and topstitching to finish 12mm from edge. Insert waist tie. Insert labels right side as worn. Set 4cm down from top edge. OH woven label on top.
NOTE- Neaten armholes before side seam neatened
Fold waist tie back on itself to fall away from garment and edge stitch down to width of strap to secure.
fin: Check ,trim, press and fold in tissue. set product sticker to bottom right hand corner of tissue.
styles.brandPlace: Rick Stein logo — top right-hand corner of the bib as worn, embroidered in white. Artwork: Rick Stein logo on file with sales (not held in the app yet).

Fold back waist tie onto apron and edgestitch down onto side seam.
fin: Trim, check, and press. thread neck strap through loop and fold garment.

fabrics: Black denim art murray 315gsm 100% cotton 1.50m width (for apron, eyelet re-inforcement pieces and pockets)
Khaki 3110 100% cotton (for neck and waist ties) — contrast marker 0597A (neck tie + ties)
trims: Thread - for waist ties and neck strap stitching
Set label just below base of re-inforcement patch in right side seam as worn. set on top of OH care label.
100% COTTON -50 degree wash/do not bleach/ 2 dot iron/P dry clean/do not tumble dry. SET LABEL JUST BELOW BASE OF RE-INFORCEMENT PATCH IN RIGHT SIDE SEAM AS WORN. SET BELOW OH WOVEN LABEL.
Set to left side of left hip pocket as worn. set level with top edge.
Quality 050b parts a/b/c/d/ 4 x male (a/b) and 2 x female (c/d)

30e/r ab antique brass eyelets 30mm . set to top of side seam. centre of eyelet 3cm down from top and 3cm in from side seam - finished. set to top edge of bib. centre of eyelet set 3cm from side of bib and 3cm from top of bib.
010B/7P - 011B - Antique brass Invert nipple rivet and post - one at each top corner of pocket
mfg: Make waist ties. stitch in matching thread. bag out both ends and topstitch one side.
Make neck strap bag out both ends and edgestitch one side. stitch in matching thread.
Discard right side as worn stud re-inforcement piece

Neaten long edge of stud re-inforcement piece turning onto right side of fabric as wrong side of fabric to be uppermost. set to left side as worn so it is included into top of bib turning and armhole turning. note set so wrong side is uppermost on finished garment.
Fold over bib top 1+3.2cm and topstitch 3cm
Edgestitch top edge
Set re-inforcement patch for eyelets. (right side of fabric uppermost)
Double turn armhole and topstitch 6mm
Double turn side seams and hem and topstitch 12mm. enclose edges of re-inforcement patch for eyelets. set labels right side seam as worn just below base of reinforcement patch
Set hip pocket hem. turn 1+2cm and twin needle top stitch. bottom row of stitching to be 2cm from top of pocket.
Set lower hip pockets to apron. set top of pocket 16cm down from finished armhole and 3.5cm in from finished side seam edge. twin needle 3 sides. insert red tax tab to left pocket as worn.
Set pen pocket stitch line 3cm wide x 13cm deep to inside edge of right pocket as worn.

Set neck strap to right side of bib as worn. edgestitching side of strap to be set to inside of neck as worn to reduce bulk. set strap to bib, box stitch strap and stitch x detail. position strap so edgestitching of base of strap end is in line with 3cm topstitching of bib.

Note apron to come back after eyelets set, to have waist ties set. set tie through eyelet 4cm and stitch down to secure. join to be on the inside as worn. boxstitch to 2 stitch wide to width of strap.
fin: Set rivets to top corners of all pockets.
Set eyelets. set centre of eyelet 3cm in from side seam and 3cm down from side seam.

Set studs to strap. female stud set to strap . set centrally to width and first stud 1.5cm from end then 4cm spacing- total 4 studs. (measurement from centre of stud) male stud set 1.5cm down and 1.5cm in from end of bib. second stud set 4cm spacing and 1.5cm in from edge of bib. vertically down.
Check , trim, press and fold. wrap in tissue, set product sticker and set into bag.
